# Optional maintainer extension

Copy only applicable blocks to the named workspace destinations. Replace placeholders with confirmed facts or explicit unknown/pending state. These are templates, not authorization to execute commands.

## AGENTS.md maintainer extension

```markdown
## Maintainer extension enabled here

Read [upstream/README.md](upstream/README.md) before feedback/upstream work. Capture reusable insights without private data for an explicitly agreed upstream batch. Do not edit managed marketplace checkouts. Maintainer opt-in, patch preparation, commits/pushes and adopted-source revisions are separate scopes.
```

## upstream/README.md

```markdown
# Upstream proposals

Explicitly enabled maintainer extension; ordinary workspaces omit this directory and all corresponding reading-map obligations.

Read this README before feedback/upstream work. Preserve each proposal's original feedback, rationale, concrete examples, resolved/rejected choices, edge cases, source targets, migration implications, acceptance checks and status. Generalize private examples before publication. Maintain links to actual proposals here.

Distinguish proposed, locally verified, prepared upstream, PR-open, merged and adopted changes. Use an agreed editable checkout, read its instructions and preserve unrelated work. Never edit a managed marketplace checkout or infer permission to publish. Retain useful detail until resolution; adoption requires a separate reviewed merge preserving local choices.
```
